signals.usability_note: Clear view of a residential frontage, though a large front-yard tree canopy partially obscures the house and roof.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Fresh red mulch ring around the front tree, trimmed hedges and a blue spruce suggest a well-kept yard, but there is no crew or equipment visible.

signals.notes: Well-maintained brick colonial-style home with a mailbox post at the curb and two cars (blue sedan and white SUV) in the driveway; the roof is only partially visible through the tree.
